title: If Dems take Congress, what can they actually do?
desc_head:
With the US midterm elections a few weeks away, Vox is bringing you conversations with our political reporters and correspondents. Today, Explained host Sean Rameswaram speaks with senior politics correspondent Andrew Prokop about the challenges a reshaped Democratic Party could face if it wins control of the House and potentially the Senate.

Subscribe to our channel! http://goo.gl/0bsAjO

Vox.com is a news website that helps you cut through the noise and understand what's really driving the events in the headlines. Check out http://www.vox.com.
